nodes.label: Fatih Sultan Mehmet Fetih Haritasını İnceliyor
nodes.rationale: AI-generated painterly image depicting a young Ottoman sultan in royal red robe, fur-trimmed mantle, white turban, and sword, standing in a dim ornate palace hall beside an empty throne. He gazes at a large map propped on an easel showing a peninsula between two waterways (resembling the Bosphorus/Golden Horn around Constantinople) with a red X marking a target location. Composition and lighting (chiaroscuro, oil-painting style) evoke a moment of strategic planning before a siege, directly illustrating the project's theme of Mehmed the Conqueror preparing for the conquest of Istanbul.
